message.content:
LeBron James (born December 30, 1984) is one of the most celebrated athletes in modern history—a dominant power‑forward/center who has spent his entire National Basketball Association (NBA) career as a marquee star.  

**Career highlights**

| Year | Team | Achievement |
|------|------|-------------|
|2003–04 | Cleveland Cavaliers | Drafted #1 overall; rookie season averages 20.9 ppg |
|2005–07 | Miami Heat | Two consecutive NBA Finals appearances |
|2010–12 | Miami Heat | Three straight NBA titles (2012, 2013, 2014); two Finals MVP awards |
|2018–19 | Los Angeles Lakers | NBA champion (2019), Finals MVP |
|2020–21 | Los Angeles Lakers | NBA champion (2020), Finals MVP |

* **MVP Awards:** Four regular‑season MVP trophies (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013).  
* **All‑Star Appearances:** 18 selections (tied for second all time).  
* **Scoring & Playmaking:** Over 35,000 points scored, more than 10,000 assists—one of only five players ever to reach both milestones.  
* **Olympics:** Gold medals at Beijing 2008, London 2012, Rio de Janeiro 2016, Tokyo 2020.  

Beyond on‑court success, LeBron is known for:

* **Philanthropy:** His *I Promise School*, a public charter school for at-risk youth in Akron, Ohio.  
* **Business Ventures:** Endorsements with Nike, Beats by Dre, and various media projects including film production through SpringHill Entertainment.  
* **Social Activism:** Vocal advocate for social justice issues, particularly those affecting African Americans and education reform.  

He remains active in the league, continuing to influence the game while also building a legacy off it.
